  • Cyber & economy: Reports of hacked hospitals and embedded spyware. Global economic toll rising; market and supply risks continue.
  • 🟢 Good News: Pakistan mediation progressing; pause window and US ceasefire plan create an opening for negotiations. US reinforcements in theater increase deterrence.
Threat assessment: escalating.
